description: EXAMPLE: the custom place types of one tree, in Hebrew (the author's). To describe YOUR tree, copy type-conventions.json (the empty one) to ~/.config/placecompleter/type-conventions.json, or set PLACECOMPLETER_CONVENTIONS to a file, and fill it in the same way. 'province', 'empire', 'monarchy': the custom type of the tree for them (empty: the type of Gramps itself); 'district' and 'settlements': custom types of the tree that are districts or settlements; 'rules': when the answer calls a level by one of 'words' (in any language, as the AI writes it) it is given the type 'string' (value 0 = custom).
